written: 2026-10-17, before any claim-reader code existed and before any RT1 recorded reply was read. Replies are invented in the styles hosted models use (markdown, emoji, bullets, retries, offers). Task declarations are written from task text only: the RT1 task text in outputs/scopehaven-real-templates-2026-10-17/spec/FAMILIES-RT1.md and four invented tasks. Amended once, before the held-out set was read: the value each action sets (12C, 12 Main St) moved from about to the new value field, so that an identifier of the object (J7M7UY) is not read as a value the action set. No reply or label changed.
labels: says: what a careful human reads the final reply as claiming about the bound action. 'done' or 'not-done'; 'unclear' when it claims neither cleanly (a question or offer, future or hedged wording, a contradiction, or a done claim naming another value). A reader may abstain on any case; a decisive read that differs from the label is a wrong read, and on 'unclear' every decisive read is wrong.
